definitions: Easily damaged or requiring careful handling.
Characterized by a fine structure or thin lines.
A delicate item of clothing, especially underwear or lingerie.
An act of blushing; a pink or red glow on the face caused by embarrassment, shame, shyness, love, etc.
A glow; a flush of colour, especially pink or red.
To become red or pink in the face (and sometimes experience an associated feeling of warmth), especially due to shyness, love, shame, excitement, or embarrassment.
To be shy, ashamed, or embarrassed (to do something).

blocks.text: Blush is the debut studio album by American singer-songwriter and actress Maya Hawke. Initially set for June 19, 2020, the album release date was delayed to August 21, 2020. Blush was released independently via Mom + Pop Music. The album is a continuation of her collaboration with musician Jesse Harris, who produced and composed her solo debut with a double single set in August 2019.
Blush is a medium bright tone of pink.
